title: Latin circuits compose like cycles; Q8 separates Latin from Mal'tsev
subject: Whether composing like cycles means Latin circuits modulo the tops, and whether it forces a Mal'tsev operation there
conclusion: A law whose circuits are all functional modulo common proper pp-definable equivalences composes like cycles, and among 3-nets of finite abelian groups exactly the p-groups do; every overlapping and non-group candidate tested failed. The 3-net of the quaternion group Q8 survived with Latin knot images yet has no polymorphism Mal'tsev modulo its top, so either it fails in larger systems or Mal'tsev structure on the tops is not forced.
